issue_context.title: Folder colors not present in Move/Duplicate menu
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3.dev5

### System information

Godot v4.3.dev5 - Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5212) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 Threads)

### Issue description

When right clicking one or multiple files in the FileSystem window and clicking the "Move/Duplicate To..." option, the dialog box that opens will not respect any folder colors that are present in the project.

### Steps to reproduce

- Select one or multiple files in the FileSystem window
- Open the right click menu
- Select "Move/Duplicate To..."
- Notice lack of folder colors present in the project's resources

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Any project with folder colors
